title: Bar Drop Fizzy Cherry Ice 10ml Nic Salts E-Liquid
description: Bar Drop Salts Fizzy Cherry Ice by Drop is a vibrant and invigorating fruit blend. It centres on the taste of deep red cherries, enhanced with a sherbet-like "fizzy" sensation that tingles on the tongue. A cooling wave of ice menthol wraps around the fruit on the exhale, creating a refreshing and stimulating vape experience. Mixed with a 40% VG / 60% PG ratio, this e-liquid is designed to maximise the impact of the fizzy sherbet notes and the clarity of the cherry flavour. Ideally suited for MTL (Mouth-to-Lung) starter kits, the nicotine salt formulation provides a smooth, gentle throat hit in 5mg, 10mg, or 20mg strengths. Bar Drop Salts is a range of nic salt e-liquids from UK manufacturer, Drop, that specialises in creating fruity flavours of astonishing authenticity and clarity.
